ir.name: ref_all_pairs_builder
ir.intuition: Reference builder: all winner/loser pairs by objective ordering.

ir.name: loss_softplus_advantage_square_sum_then_mean
ir.intuition: This loss maintains the softplus transformation of the difference in log probabilities weighted by the squared advantage gap, emphasizing pairs with stronger preference signals, but aggregates the loss first by summing over instances within each batch before averaging across the batch. This hierarchical aggregation can better capture total pairwise loss contributions per instance before normalization.
ir.pseudocode:
adv_sq = advantage_gap ^ 2
score_diff = log_prob_w - log_prob_l
loss = softplus(-score_diff) * adv_sq * weight
loss_per_instance = sum(loss over instance pairs)
final_loss = mean(loss_per_instance)
